Phase F: Flutter guest app (F0 foundation + F1 screens + F2 realtime) + GitHub Actions CI/release + WhatsApp destination editable in check-in wizard

- mobile/: Flutter guest app — pubspec, Android platform (flavors dev/prod), theme (navy/gold + Cairo + RTL), ApiClient (401→renew→retry per CONTRACTS §1.2.1), models for all 16 guest endpoints, SessionController, GuestStore, RealtimeService (socket.io XTransformPort=3002), login + guest shell + home/stay/services/bill/requests/chat/notifications/4 action sheets (ported screen-by-screen from web reference)
- .github/workflows: mobile-ci (analyze+test+debug APK smoke), mobile-release (signed APK → GitHub Release, keystore from repo secrets), web-ci (bun lint + 157 tests, symlinked fixed root)
- reception/check-in-wizard: WhatsApp destination number now editable by staff (defaults to guest phone)
- keystore generated & uploaded as encrypted repo secrets (not committed)
- .gitignore: scope stray 'test' pattern to /test so mobile/test/ is tracked
